title: Sonate Op. 74
identity: Tonger publishes Günter Raphael’s Sonata Op. 74a for alto saxophone and piano. EDA Records’ album page identifies its 1957 date and three movements; a recording by Frank Lunte and pianist Tatjana Blome is indexed with individual movement durations. This is distinct from Raphael’s Op. 74 Divertimento for alto saxophone and cello.

evidence.claim: EDA Records identifies Sonata Op.74a (1957) and lists Con moto, Vivace, and Allegro molto energico as its three movements.
Qobuz credits alto saxophonist Frank Lunte and pianist Tatjana Blome on the EDA album; individual movement durations are 3:41, 4:25 and 4:23.
Institutional library record identifies the printed Tonger score for alto saxophone and piano, 23 pages plus saxophone part.
Retailer lists the Tonger edition for alto saxophone and piano.

review_focus: The published tempo/movement labels suggest contrast between con moto, Vivace and an energetic Allegro molto; review technical and ensemble demands from score rather than inferring level from the recording.
collection_flag: Original mid-century saxophone sonata; verified published recording and institutional score holding.

listening.description: Album listing with saxophone and piano credits and movement tracks.

gaps: No college syllabus or pedagogical placement located.
